cc:Work.dc:description: Replay of the full unweighted seven-parameter joint audit: 140 Sun P–V–T rows and 34 Gréaux acoustic rows. Pressure, bulk modulus and shear modulus are separate outputs. Curves are labelled representative isotherms; residuals use every measured V,T. Mixed-temperature points are not connected as one isotherm. Elastic observations and propagated widths use the audit's density/VP/VS reductions. For the registered Peritheos record, the complete stored seven-parameter audit fit supplies the auxiliary shear parameters; the catalog record itself stores only the pressure-producing subset. Source weighting and covariance remain unknown; published non-parity and recommendation findings are unchanged.
